description: Fly, Walk, a place, look around, walk (regression 2026-10-27, Every kit). Walking (a site's own player driving the camera) shows what flying shows: the sky half of the same views on the deck and the dock walking and flying, captured and compared (the plains' ground drawn over the eye as a slanted wall). Walk falls from where the camera is (no jump); at the bunker's Loft, outdoors and on the cargo ship (casting off) the bunker's own player walks there (its collisions, its moving deck): it falls to the floor, looks around and walks on from there. Every scenario with the bunker.

steps.note: deck-90: walking, then flying from that eye

steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.viewList.find(v => v.name === 'Loft').inst, V = s.world.app.world.vehicles[0], p = V.toWorld([V.pivot[0], V.hull.deck + 1.7, V.pivot[2]]), a = 90 * Math.PI / 180, v = { pos: p, fwd: [Math.sin(a), 0, -Math.cos(a)], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1.05 }; if (entities.shared) entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld(v)); else s.world.setView(v); return entities.controller?.id ?? null; })()

steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.skySite, F = entities.siteFrame(s), q = F.local(entities.fly.view.pos), x = q[0] + 3000, z = q[2], g = entities.floorIn(s, x, 1e5, z); entities.setWorldView(F.toWorld({ pos: [x, g + 1.62, z], fwd: [1, 0, 0], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 })); return entities.controller?.id ?? null; })()

(() => { entities.__steps = 0; if (!entities.__stepHook) { const e = entities.emit.bind(entities); entities.emit = (s, n, p) => { if (n === 'step') entities.__steps++; return e(s, n, p); }; entities.__stepHook = true; } return true; })()

(() => { const s = entities.viewList.find(v => v.name === 'Loft').inst, V = s.world.app.world.vehicles[0], p = V.toWorld([V.pivot[0], V.hull.deck + 3, V.pivot[2]]), v = { pos: p, fwd: [1, 0, 0], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 }; if (entities.shared) entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld(v)); else if (entities.fly) entities.fly.view = v; else s.world.setView(v); return v.pos; })()

(() => { const s = entities.viewList.find(v => v.name === 'Loft').inst, V = s.world.app.world.vehicles[0], c = s.world.view.pos, m = V.inv; return m[1] * c[0] + m[5] * c[1] + m[9] * c[2] + m[13] - V.hull.deck; })()
